quest.title: Surrounded by the Aroma of Tea
quest.description: "There seems to be a very unusual customer in the tavern..." "Well, it isn't every day that someone piques your interest. How about we go check this person out together?" "Forget it... I wouldn't dare to utter a word in front of him even if I went."

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler. Good to see you, I trust you are well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wait... Uh, Zhongli, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: If I am to roam about the world, then I certainly mustn't limit my destinations. The free and prosperous Land of Wind is as splendid a place to visit as any.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: And it's quite a pleasant surprise to run into you here.

choices.text: Can I get you a drink?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: One Misty Garden please. I take my tea strong, thank you.

choices.text: We can chat over a cup of tea.

talks.objective: Head to the counter and get ready to open for business

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Mmm, the tea is clear and glows with a pleasing hue. Its richness is complemented by a floral and fruity fragrance. Exquisite.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so Zhongli is even super knowledgeable about tea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon usually just gulps down the tea and says something simple like, "Yummy yummy in Paimon's tummy."

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Mindfully savoring the tea shows due respect to the person that brewed it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Tea of good quality is hard to come by, and those capable of brewing tea according to the occasion and emotions even more so.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So could you teach Paimon how to savor tea like you do? It seems you smell it first, then drink it, right?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That's correct.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Every type of tea is unique. The more you drink, the more you will understand the subtle differences. Smelling the aroma will reveal the quality of the tea.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Lower-grade teas emit a musty and seemingly scorched scent, whereas ones with a delicate yet soothing aroma are usually of a higher quality.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If you want to be more particular, according to Liyue ancient tradition, you could acquire a "Vintage Goblet," which is used specifically for examining the aroma.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no, all this time, Paimon's been missing out on her tea...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Not to worry. Knowledge is vast, it's never too late to learn.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: As a beginner, you can try this method: first observe the color. Then, smell the fragrance... And finally, take a sip.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Remember, you can understand anything as long as you approach it in the proper order.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Qiaoying Village in northwest Liyue is famous for their tea industry. It would be well worthwhile the visit when you get the chance.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: What I shared with you today are mostly my own habits as an old-fashioned Liyue local.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Each region has its own tea traditions and culture. One should always respect the conventions of the local region.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it! But whether Paimon can remember it all is another story, hehe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Classic Paimon.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: #Thank you for such excellent tea, {NICKNAME}. It made my trip out here all the more worthwhile.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If you ever come to manage a tea house, I will certainly be a regular.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we're already pretty busy. I don't think we'll have time to manage a side hustle at a tea house.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, who knows...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Regardless, you have my complete support.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Let's call it a day. I won't take more of your time. All the best with your new pursuit.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Ah yes, the bill... Just put it on Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's tab, as usual.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course... Take care! Give our regards to the director!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this doesn't look like the drink they ordered. Just give this one to Paimon and try making another.
